say:3:1910829002:1.text: You want us to cast aside our godhood, our power, everything that makes us what we are, and become mortal?
say:3:1910829002:1.source_cn: 舍弃神格，舍弃权柄，舍弃自我，舍弃我们之所以为我们的东...

say:4:1910829003:1.text: 如果那<style="highlight">能让神明避免堕落的命运</style>，不必成为我必须讨伐的对象，那么是的。我觉得这或许是一种方法。
say:4:1910829003:1.source_cn: 如果那<style=highlight>能让神明避免堕...

say:5:1910829004:1.text: Dear sister, you always carry the struggles of mortals in your heart and bring their fears into the discussion of gods.
say:5:1910829004:1.source_cn: 亲爱的妹妹，你总是把凡人的挣扎放在心里，也把凡人的恐惧...

say:6:1910829005:1.text: Gods fall from grace because we are tainted by the original sin. I've already used my power to escape that taint. Why should I destroy myself?
say:6:1910829005:1.source_cn: 神会堕落，是因为我们被原罪侵染，我已经用自己的权能逃脱...

say:7:1910829006:1.text: Are you afraid of becoming mortal, Oceana? You've shattered yourself into fragments and lived through cycle after cycle of awakening. Do you still not understand?
say:7:1910829006:1.source_cn: 你惧怕成为凡人吗，奥汐娜？你将自己拆成碎片，历经数个复...

say:8:1910829007:1.text: The fragments you birthed do exist. They feel real pain and real joy. And they aren't you, nor can they ever truly become you.
say:8:1910829007:1.source_cn: 你所繁育出的碎片的确存在，他们经历着真实的痛苦和幸福，...

say:9:1910829008:1.text: If they were truly you, they should've been able to use the power of birth to bear children of their own. But they lack that inborn gift of life because you alone hold the true power of birth.
say:9:1910829008:1.source_cn: 他们若真是你，本该可以运用繁育的力量自行诞下子嗣。但他...

say:10:1910829009:1.text: You merely sleep, and in the end, you harvest the memories and feelings of all of the living creatures you birthed and bestow upon them what you fancy as a merciful eternal slumber.
say:10:1910829009:1.source_cn: 你只是沉睡，最终撷取了所诞之物的记忆和情感，并自以为慈...

say:11:1910829010:1.text: You said that even gods can change. Then try, Oceana. I do not ask you to descend from your station. That is too dangerous. But the next time, listen to them.
say:11:1910829010:1.source_cn: 你说，神也可以改变。那么，试一试吧，奥汐娜，我不希求你...

say:12:1910829011:1.text: Those beings born of you, the Merfolk. They came from you, but in the end they aren't you... You will understand.
say:12:1910829011:1.source_cn: 那些诞生于你的存在，那些海裔——他们来自于你，但终究不...

say:13:1910829012:1.text: Dear sister, why do you speak of descension so suddenly? What did you see in lands above the sea?
say:13:1910829012:1.source_cn: 妹妹，为什么突然提出降格，你在陆地上见到了什么？

say:14:1910829013:1.text: You are not the only one who tried to escape this fate. The others have all failed. They could slow the fall from grace, but in the end, they walked into it just the same.
say:14:1910829013:1.source_cn: 试图摆脱命运的不止你一人，姐姐。但是他们都失败了，他们...

say:15:1910829014:1.text: As long as you still use your powers, the fall will come, sooner or later. You may have delayed it. But one day...
say:15:1910829014:1.source_cn: 只要还在运用自己的权柄，堕落迟早都会降临。你或许延缓了...

say:16:1910829015:1.text: Then has anyone ever succeeded in descension? Were they still themselves?
say:16:1910829015:1.source_cn: 那么，有人成功降格吗？他们还是他们自己吗？

say:17:1910829016:1.text: ... No one was willing to give up their powers, so I have no way of knowing.
say:17:1910829016:1.source_cn: ……没人愿意舍弃自己的权柄，所以我也无从知晓。

say:18:1910829017:1.text: But you're different. You're already changing yourself. You lack only the last step.
say:18:1910829017:1.source_cn: 但你不一样，你已经在改变自我，只差跨越最后一步。

say:19:1910829018:1.text: And what about you? You're still experimenting with creating life. Won't the fall come for you too?
say:19:1910829018:1.source_cn: 那你怎么办，你还在进行创造生命的实验，难道堕落不会找上你吗？

say:20:1910829019:1.text: I only need to succeed once. A being that transcends the Tree of Life will change everything. I truly believe that.
say:20:1910829019:1.source_cn: 一次，只要成功一次就好……超脱生命树的存在会改变一切，...

say:21:1910829020:1.text: Then let us each take a step back, dear sister. If that is your wish, the next time I awaken, I will speak with my fragments properly.
say:21:1910829020:1.source_cn: 那么我们就都各退一步吧，亲爱的妹妹，既然这是你的愿望，...

say:22:1910829021:1.text: But until then, do not attempt descension. Try whatever other methods you wish. Enough gods are gone already. I don't want to lose my sister too... in any form.
say:22:1910829021:1.source_cn: 但是在那之前，不要试图降格，你尽可以去尝试其他方法。离...

say:24:1910829023:1.text: I'm glad you told me. It means you're still trying to save me. That makes me happy.
say:24:1910829023:1.source_cn: 我很感谢你能告诉我，说明你还在想方设法救你的姐姐，我很...

say:25:1910829024:1.text: Then, may I skip the seaweed salad tonight?
say:25:1910829024:1.source_cn: 那，今夜可以不再吃海藻沙拉了吗？

narration:28:1910829026:1.text: Conversation... dinner... two of them together...
narration:28:1910829026:1.male: Conversation... dinner... two of them together...
narration:28:1910829026:1.female: Conversation... dinner... two of them together...

say:30:1910829028:1.text: You watch Dura's figure fade away. Oceana's memories do not appear from nothing. In this strange realm, mind and memory bleed into each other, each one shaping the next.
say:30:1910829028:1.source_cn: 你凝望着艾雅的身影渐渐消失，是海月一家的晚餐带出了奥汐...
say:30:1910829028:1.male: You watch Dura's figure fade away. Oceana's memories do not appear from nothing. In this strange realm, mind and memory bleed into each other, each one shaping the next.
say:30:1910829028:1.female: You watch Dura's figure fade away. Oceana's memories do not appear from nothing. In this strange realm, mind and memory bleed into each other, each one shaping the next.

say:31:1910829029:1.text: Oceana's memories keep surfacing. It may be because of your arrival or because of the Merfolk's minds... or perhaps it's both. It may be that your arrival is what woke the Merfolk's minds in the first place.
say:31:1910829029:1.source_cn: 搅动相关的记忆，或许也可以带回海裔们的意识，而这附近出...
say:31:1910829029:1.male: Oceana's memories keep surfacing. It may be because of your arrival or because of the Merfolk's minds... or perhaps it's both. It may be that your arrival is what woke the Merfolk's minds in the first place.
say:31:1910829029:1.female: Oceana's memories keep surfacing. It may be because of your arrival or because of the Merfolk's minds... or perhaps it's both. It may be that your arrival is what woke the Merfolk's minds in the first place.

say:32:1910829030:1.text: By that logic, if you stir up the right memories, you can bring back more of Merfolk's minds. And the notes appearing nearby may represent their strongest memories...
say:32:1910829030:1.source_cn: 你的心中涌起一首首曲调，那是海裔们曾经唱响的歌谣。
say:32:1910829030:1.male: By that logic, if you stir up the right memories, you can bring back more of Merfolk's minds. And the notes appearing nearby may represent their strongest memories...
say:32:1910829030:1.female: By that logic, if you stir up the right memories, you can bring back more of Merfolk's minds. And the notes appearing nearby may represent their strongest memories...

say:33:1910829031:1.text: Melodies well up in your heart. You remember the songs the Merfolk once sang. This may be one of the best ways to call their consciousness back.
say:33:1910829031:1.source_cn: 这或许是唤回他们意识的最佳方式之一！
say:33:1910829031:1.male: Melodies well up in your heart. You remember the songs the Merfolk once sang. This may be one of the best ways to call their consciousness back.
say:33:1910829031:1.female: Melodies well up in your heart. You remember the songs the Merfolk once sang. This may be one of the best ways to call their consciousness back.
